governance: SEC-18: every third-party SDK that ships in a client artifact (client/ — iOS, Android, Flutter, web) must appear in this list before merge. The CI gate (scripts/check_sdk_allowlist.py via the sdk-allowlist job) is fail-closed: a dependency with no matching entry fails the build. Entries are added by PR with the justification and data-access review recorded inline; removal of an entry without removing the dependency also fails the build.

fields.name: package identity in its ecosystem (npm package name, pub.dev package, CocoaPods pod, Maven group:artifact)
fields.versionConstraint: exact version or caret/tilde range the client manifest must satisfy
fields.dataAccess: what personal data the SDK can touch — drives the SEC-12 DPIA linkage

sdks.name: expo
sdks.justification: Expo SDK runtime — the managed workflow layer the custom dev client is built on (TECH-01).
sdks.dataAccess: none beyond the platform APIs the app itself declares
sdks.approvedBy: ADR-0001 sequencing; batch-34 client foundation PR

sdks.name: react
sdks.justification: UI runtime required by React Native 0.88 (TECH-01).
sdks.dataAccess: none — renders local component state only
sdks.approvedBy: ADR-0001 sequencing; batch-34 client foundation PR

sdks.name: react-native
sdks.justification: The client framework itself (TECH-01); pinned to the Expo SDK 58 pairing.
sdks.dataAccess: platform device APIs as declared in app.json (BLE, location)
sdks.approvedBy: ADR-0001 sequencing; batch-34 client foundation PR

sdks.name: expo-dev-client
sdks.justification: The custom dev client itself — Expo Go is prohibited because BLE needs native modules (TECH-01/TR-31).

sdks.name: expo-secure-store
sdks.justification: TR-30: platform-keystore backing for the session refresh token; secrets must not sit in plain AsyncStorage.
sdks.dataAccess: session credentials (stored, never transmitted by the SDK)

sdks.name: expo-status-bar
sdks.justification: Status bar styling from the root component.

sdks.name: h3-js
sdks.justification: TR-29: on-device H3 cell computation — the same governed library and version family the match service uses, so cells agree bit-for-bit.
sdks.dataAccess: location fix in memory, transformed to a coarse cell id on device; raw coordinates never leave

sdks.name: centrifuge
sdks.justification: AMD-CRT-04: the Centrifugo realtime client — pair-lifecycle and messaging events over the governed websocket tier; admitted through the TECH-16 dependency gate (batch 66).
sdks.dataAccess: receives pair/user channel events over TLS after presenting a server-scoped connection token; transmits no data of its own

sdks.name: typescript
sdks.justification: Build toolchain — pinned with the services for one compiler across the repo.

sdks.name: @types/node
sdks.justification: Types for the node --test unit suites; pinned with the services.

sdks.name: @types/react
sdks.justification: React 19 type definitions for the RN surface typecheck.
